categories.evidence: Nobody at the branch asked him a single question
categories.why: An 82-year-old customer was defrauded of $9,000 in a grandparent scam through unusual cash withdrawals that branch staff did not question, raising elder-exploitation and bank-handling concerns.
The complaint reports money taken by a scammer and asks what the bank will do, which falls under the category's scam-loss criteria and warrants dispute review.
